definitions.explanation: The office or organization responsible for publishing a book, periodical, or document. Commonly printed on the copyright page of Japanese books.

examples.japanese: {発行所|はっこうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥付|おくづけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{発行所|はっこうしょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The publisher is listed on the colophon page of the book.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発行所|はっこうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧だ。
examples.english: The publisher of this magazine is a small publishing company based in Osaka.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{発行|はっこう}→発行：03693_hakkou⟧ (publication; issuance) + ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place; office). This term appears on the {奥付|おくづけ} (colophon) page found at the back of Japanese books, alongside the {発行者|はっこうしゃ} (publisher name), {発行日|はっこうび} (publication date), and printing information.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発行所|はっこうしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: publisher's address
- {発行所|はっこうしょ}{名|めい}: publisher name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}→出版社：11765_shuppansha⟧: publishing company — the more commonly used everyday term for a publisher; {発行所|はっこうしょ} is the formal term used in copyright information
- {発行者|はっこうしゃ}: publisher (person) — refers to the individual or entity responsible for publication
- {印刷所|いんさつしょ}: printing office — the place that physically prints the publication, distinct from the publisher
